title: One side, one turn
heading: One side, one turn
description: Help the robot patrol the dotted square. It starts facing right. Move three tiles, then turn right. Which way will it face? Run starts it at START again.

scene.label: A robot starts in the upper left corner of a dotted square, facing right. Each side is three tiles long. Its trail shows the instructions it follows.

completions.description: Turn a quarter turn to the right, without moving

feedback.success: It now faces down. Turning changes its direction; it does not change its tile.
